opening.argument: The presentation is framed as a CNBC business-news interview with Tobias Levkovich, identified as Citi's chief U.S. equity strategist, discussing the state of the markets. Its substance is analytical and cautious: the speaker warns that “there's going to be a lot of bad news on the earnings flow” and describes recovery as slow, while also cautioning against interpreting economic figures directly from a market-trading perspective. The interview branding and market graphics reinforce an ordinary reporting context. Nothing presented promises a return, requires payment, requests personal data, or directs viewers to participate in an investment scheme, supporting a financial-news and market-analysis context rather than deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: Tobias Levkovich, Citi Chief U.S. Equity Strategist, joins "Closing Bell" to discuss the state of the markets.
there's going to be a lot of bad news on the earnings flow. It's going to be a slow recovery when you come out of this.
